name: Sinker Count
description: Coils the net in loose loops over the shoulder so the weighted hem hangs evenly and nothing snags on release.

name: Flat Knotwork
description: Swings the net out low from the hip so the mesh opens in a flat disc over the opponent's legs.

name: Nabbing Meshgrid
description: Drags the weighted hem along the ground to catch the ankles of a charging opponent and pull them off balance.

name: Drawcord Amble
description: Keeps one corner pinched in the off hand while stepping aside so the net trails clean behind.

name: Sinkerhusk
description: Whips the folded net across the forearm to turn a thrust aside before the mesh tangles the blade.

name: Meshcount
description: Pinches the mesh at the knuckles and feels the lead weights swing to find the net's true balance.

name: Straight Billow
description: Hurls the net overhead from a rising stance so it spreads wide and falls across the opponent's shoulders.

name: Short Spread
description: Whips the leaded hem sharply into the opponent's hand to force a dropped weapon.

name: Backward Weave
description: Backs away while paying out the throw line so the cord never tightens or catches a heel.

name: Drapelid
description: Hauls a net already draped on the opponent hard toward the thrower so the arms bind to the sides.

name: Weavewedge
description: Sweeps the open net before the body like a curtain to foul an incoming thrown stone.

name: Weavegauge
description: Runs a thumb along the hem to count lead weights and find a torn or loose one before the throw.

name: Narrow Floatrope
description: Lofts the net high with both hands so it drops in a wide circle over several opponents standing close.

name: Tripping Loopmesh
description: Trails the hem low behind the thrower then flips it up around the knees of a pursuer.

name: Angled Mesh
description: Spins on the ball of one foot with the net circling at arm's length to bat away thrown darts.

name: Drape Blow
description: Jabs the knotted corner of the net into the opponent's eye or throat like a short blunt spike.

name: Weavehusk
description: Lets the mesh sag open in front of the chest to snag and slow a swung club.

name: Billowcowl
description: Slips the wrist cord free mid-throw when an opponent grabs the net so the thrower is not dragged forward.

name: Even Weave
description: Draws the mesh through the palm to feel its open width and fix how far it will spread.

name: Stiff Hemcord
description: Flings the net from the tether hand while the free hand steadies the trailing hem.

name: Tripping Smother
description: Snaps the tether back hard so a snared opponent is yanked off their feet.

name: Spreadlid
description: Holds the net behind the back and swings an empty arm to lure the opponent into a rush.

name: Billow Lid
description: Spins once on a short tether so the net wraps around the opponent's weapon arm.

name: Haulinamble
description: Slides down a bank or rise with the net trailing to gain ground without losing grip.

name: Meshgrid Pause
description: Folds the mesh in several layers over the forearm to take a blow on the padded bundle.

name: Hemcord Drop
description: Raps a leaded weight against the opponent's knuckles to make them release a hold.

name: Measured Leadedge
description: Settles both hands on the hoop rim and reads the bag's weight to know how far it will reach.

name: Hitching Smother
description: Scoops the hoop up under a lifted foot to throw the opponent off balance mid-step.

name: Square Spread
description: Slams the rim of the hooped bag against the opponent's shin in a short downward chop.

name: Settled Drawcord
description: Raises the stiff hoop edge to catch and turn aside a descending blade.

name: Easing Enmesh
description: Hops backward with the hoop held at the chest to open a gap from a lunge.

name: Haulinhusk
description: Drops the hooped net over a limb and presses the pole down to pin it to the ground.

name: Gentle Knotwork
description: Runs a thin thread of qi through the cords until the mesh answers with an even tension.

name: Spreadstrike
description: Releases the net on the outbreath so a pulse of qi spreads the mesh fully open in flight.

name: Spreadwedge
description: Sends a pulse of qi down the cord so the draped mesh tightens around the opponent's torso.

name: Weavepace
description: Lets qi lighten the lead hem so the thrower glides a pace sideways with the net trailing.

name: Meshstay
description: Stiffens the hem with a flash of qi and swings it to rap a thrust off line.

name: Mesh Gauge
description: Pays out the lead line to its marks and reads from the tension how far the net will fly.

name: Haulindash
description: Throws on a rising step so the mesh opens at the top of its arc and drops flat on the target.

name: Loopmesh Strike
description: Whips a lead sinker on the line into the opponent's forearm to break their grip.

name: Stepping Drape
description: Crouches and turns while gathering the line so the thrower exits a clash with the net ready.

name: Sinker Wedge
description: Holds the breath and snaps the line taut so the mesh clamps the opponent's legs together.

name: Leadedge Husk
description: Lets a draped section of mesh slide over a blade edge so the cut skids away harmlessly.

name: Locking Enmesh
description: Reels the line in steady pulls so a tangled opponent cannot get back to their feet.

name: Loopmesh Count
description: Watches the ring of the net open against the sky and judges where its edge will land.

name: Knotwork Strike
description: Spins the net off the fingertips so qi opens a clean ring that settles over the target's head and arms.

name: Quick Sinker
description: Snaps the weighted ring edge against the opponent's wrist as a quick punishing flick.

name: Fouling Floatrope
description: Waits for the net to settle then draws the skirt cord tight before the opponent can shrug it off.

name: Tight Leadedge
description: Fans the net skirt wide with a qi snap to smother a hurled spear's point.

name: Drapepace
description: Shifts the feet in small drifting steps beneath the falling net to stay clear of the tangle.

name: Calm Hemcord
description: Tugs the purse cord through its rings to confirm it runs free before the net is thrown.

name: Leaden Floatrope
description: Hurls the purse net so its open mouth faces the target and swallows an arm or a leg.

name: Spreadpause
description: Yanks the closing cord so the purse mouth snaps shut around the opponent's limbs.

name: Sudden Haulin
description: Flicks the knotted cord end across the opponent's cheek to sting and blur their sight.

name: Pulling Haulin
description: Lets the purse hang open and slack to look careless then snaps it up when the opponent steps in.

name: Ready Drawcord
description: Winds the closing cord around the wrist and uses the taut length to strike a blade from its path.

name: Easing Meshgrid
description: Steps sidelong while the cord pays out so the opponent's charge runs past the thrower.

name: Raised Weave
description: Pulls the net over the head and shoulders as a loose hood against falling debris and arrows.

name: Sinkergauge
description: Slings two folded nets from one cord and feels their weights so neither swings loose.

name: Firm Mesh
description: Casts the first net short to draw a dodge then sends the second long to catch where they land.

name: Pulling Enmesh
description: Throws the spare net over an opponent already struggling in the first so the bind doubles.

name: Pushing Spread
description: Stretches the cord linking both nets across the opponent's path to snag a stride.

name: Weavestay
description: Raises the spare net in the off hand to knock a cut aside while the main hand readies a throw.

name: Backward Haulin
description: Crosses the rear foot over the front while gathering both nets to reset the range.
